records.instruction: Lift the portable laptop's lid gently.
Pull up the foldable laptop's lid.
Open the flat orange laptop with care
Reach and grab the smooth wooden roller with both arms
Grab the wooden roller on the table using arms
Hold the light brown cylindrical roller with both arms.
Pick the hammer with claw and smooth head up and hit the block
Use the right arm to grab the silver hammer head and claw then beat block
Use the hammer with claw and smooth head to strike the block
Press the switch with circular black buttons using the right arm
Use the left arm to press the small beige switch with angular sides.
Click the small beige switch with angular sides using the right arm
Use the right arm to grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom upright
Use the left arm to grab the plastic soda bottle upright
Use the right arm to grab the brown bottle head-up.
